target_customer: Teams that run AI agents in production and need monitoring, failure detection and evals
problem: AI agents fail silently without throwing errors. Moda reads production traces, groups failures by user impact, and replays prompt or tool changes against past failures before shipping.
business_model: B2B SaaS, usage based on traces

founders.name: Pranav Bedi
founders.background_notes: Built data infrastructure at banks and insurers, per the YC page.

founders.name: Mohammed Al-Rasheed
founders.background_notes: Built AI agents and infrastructure at those companies, per the YC page.

competitors.name: Braintrust
competitors.what: Evals and observability platform for AI agents
competitors.traction_then: Named as the leading evals platform in 2026 roundups

competitors.name: Langfuse
competitors.what: MIT licensed open source LLM observability, self hosted or cloud

competitors.name: Arize
competitors.what: Arize AX enterprise agent monitoring and Phoenix open source

competitors.name: HoneyHive
competitors.what: Evals and observability for AI agents

technical_complexity.rationale: Trace ingestion at scale, LLM judged failure clustering and replay of changes against historical traffic are standard engineering with some hard ML parts.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated trace data and eval suites create some lock in, but several funded and open source competitors offer overlapping features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Observability vendors already marketed agent monitoring in 2026. No acquisition of Moda reported.

market_need_then: Production agents were spreading quickly in 2025 and 2026, and a crowded set of tools reflects strong spend and pain around agent reliability.

branding.domain_note: Uses moda.dev, not moda.com or moda.app.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short and direct, built on the tagline 'Your agents should never make the same mistake twice.'

branding.brand_signature: The never make the same mistake twice tagline

brand_strength.rationale: Short name but widely shared with other Moda companies, including an AI design company at moda.app that raised $7.5M, which blurs search and press.

outcome_analysis: Moda is an active Winter 2026 company with two Waterloo dropout founders who built agents at Shopify and Notion. No funding or traction was verified. It competes in the crowded agent observability space against funded vendors, so the story is unwritten and name confusion with other Moda companies is a minor issue.
notes: Funding search mostly returned moda.app, a different AI design company that raised $7.5M, which must not be attributed to moda.dev. One aggregator lists $500K for moda.dev and Preqin lists a Moda Flows seed from Pioneer Fund in March 2026; both unverified and not recorded. Competitors come from roundups dated March 2026 near the batch. HoneyHive source date was not captured.
